pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Steinitz Defence
pages.notes: Overview said 3...d6, but this page is reached by 2...d6 3.d4 Nc6 4.Bb5; plan 1 played c3-d4 with the pawn already on d4. Rewritten; reviewer rejected a Nb1-d2-f1-g3 plan for this d4 structure (Nc3 is normal), fixed and accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Black take on d4 before White has a d-pawn there; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Old Steinitz, 4.d4 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black capture its own c6-knight with ...Bxc6; plan 1 said Bxc6 doubles Black's pawns (the d7-bishop recaptures); overview said Bd7 challenges the bishop. Rewritten; reviewer rejected Nbd2-f1-g3 and ...f5 for this line, replaced by the Re1 build-up (Tarrasch trap) and ...exd4 with e-file play, accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Old Steinitz, 4.d4 exd4 5.Nxd4
pages.notes: Plan 3 named ...c5 inside White's plan; plan 4 wrote ...0-0 with zeros; overview missed that the c6-knight is attacked twice. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Old Steinitz, 4.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave the Spanish knight manoeuvre to the f3-knight, with the rook on f1 and the d-pawn on d2. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Black attack its own e4-pawn after ...fxe4; plan 2 named an f7-pawn that has moved to f5; plan 4 castled White queenside. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense, Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black trap an a7-knight the a8-rook can simply take; plan 4 named a central pawn mass that is a lone e4-pawn. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense, Möhring Variation
pages.notes: Overview said White sacrifices material (White is a pawn up, with queen and c6-knight both attacked); plan 4 played ...b5 onto the bishop. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense, Möhring Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...c5 and d4 in a confused general plan; rewritten around the stranded a7-knight and the g5-queen's pressure on g2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense, Möhring Variation
pages.notes: Overview credited Black with the bishop pair (the d7-bishop has just been taken) and one pawn; plan 1 routed the knight Nc8-b6 without its first step. Rewritten. British spelling.
